profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker DT. According to its website, it sells observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, and describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader. The site says the platform is built for the age of AI and is intended to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes, turning data into decisions and autonomous actions.

The site states that the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management, a view attributed to Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC. A customer quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing root cause identification from hours to minutes.

The company's record shows a CIK of 0001773383 and a Massachusetts law exposure count of 191. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
